# MAIN BASELINE

```{r}
# 1. Fast / slow scan thresholds
p5_time  <- quantile(basket_data$avg_time_per_item, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_time <- quantile(basket_data$avg_time_per_item, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Basket size group
basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    fast_flag = avg_time_per_item < p5_time,
    slow_flag = avg_time_per_item > p95_time,

    basket_size_group = case_when(
      total_items <= 10 ~ "small",
      total_items <= 25 ~ "medium",
      TRUE ~ "large"
    )
  )

# 3. Expected time given basket size
model_time <- lm(avg_time_per_item ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_time_given_size = predict(model_time, newdata = basket_data),
    time_deviation = avg_time_per_item - expected_time_given_size
  )

# 4. Expected price given basket size
model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items,
    price_residual = residuals(model_price),
    price_concentration = max_price / total_price
  )
```

```{r}
# 5. Department co-occurrence score
dept_data <- long_data_clean %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

pairs <- dept_data %>%
  inner_join(dept_data, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  rename(
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

co_occurrence <- pairs %>%
  count(dept_1, dept_2, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(score = n / max(n))

pairs_scored <- pairs %>%
  left_join(co_occurrence, by = c("dept_1", "dept_2"))

co_score <- pairs_scored %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    co_occurrence_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(co_score, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    co_occurrence_score = replace_na(co_occurrence_score, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
# 6. Thresholds for risk rules
p5_price  <- quantile(basket_data$total_price, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_price <- quantile(basket_data$total_price, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p5_resid  <- quantile(basket_data$price_residual, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_resid <- quantile(basket_data$price_residual, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p95_conc <- quantile(basket_data$price_concentration, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p5_co <- quantile(basket_data$co_occurrence_score, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

# 7. Rule-based risk score
basket_risk <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    fast_scan = avg_time_per_item < p5_time,
    slow_scan = avg_time_per_item > p95_time,

    low_total_price = total_price < p5_price,
    high_total_price = total_price > p95_price,

    unusually_cheap_for_size = price_residual < p5_resid,
    unusually_expensive_for_size = price_residual > p95_resid,

    high_price_concentration = price_concentration > p95_conc,

    unusual_department_combination = co_occurrence_score < p5_co,

    risk_score =
      as.integer(fast_scan) +
      as.integer(slow_scan) +
      as.integer(low_total_price) +
      as.integer(high_total_price) +
      as.integer(unusually_cheap_for_size) +
      as.integer(unusually_expensive_for_size) +
      as.integer(high_price_concentration) +
      as.integer(unusual_department_combination)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(risk_score))
```

```{r}
table(basket_risk$risk_score)

top_risky <- basket_risk %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    time_deviation,
    price_deviation,
    price_concentration,
    co_occurrence_score,
    risk_score
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(risk_score)) %>%
  head(20)

knitr::kable(top_risky)

basket_risk %>%
  group_by(risk_score) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_time = mean(avg_time_per_item),
    avg_price = mean(total_price),
    avg_items = mean(total_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(
  top_risky,
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/test cases/top_risky"
)
```

# Fraud risk detection on unseen data: case0

```{r}
case0_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case12.csv", warn = FALSE)

case0_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(case0_lines),
  basket = case0_lines
)

case0_long <- case0_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case0_basket <- case0_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
case0_dept_data <- case0_long %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

case0_pairs <- case0_dept_data %>%
  inner_join(case0_dept_data, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  rename(
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

case0_co_score <- case0_pairs %>%
  left_join(
    co_occurrence %>% select(dept_1, dept_2, score),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    co_occurrence_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case0_basket <- case0_basket %>%
  left_join(case0_co_score, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    co_occurrence_score = replace_na(co_occurrence_score, 0),

    expected_time_given_size = predict(model_time, newdata = .),
    time_deviation = avg_time_per_item - expected_time_given_size,

    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = .),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items,

    price_concentration = max_price / total_price
  )
```

```{r}
case0_basket <- case0_basket %>%
  mutate(
    fast_scan = avg_time_per_item < p5_time,
    slow_scan = avg_time_per_item > p95_time,

    low_total_price = total_price < p5_price,
    high_total_price = total_price > p95_price,

    unusually_cheap_for_size = price_deviation < p5_resid,
    unusually_expensive_for_size = price_deviation > p95_resid,

    high_price_concentration = price_concentration > p95_conc,
    unusual_department_combination = co_occurrence_score < p5_co,

    risk_score =
      as.integer(fast_scan) +
      as.integer(slow_scan) +
      as.integer(low_total_price) +
      as.integer(high_total_price) +
      as.integer(unusually_cheap_for_size) +
      as.integer(unusually_expensive_for_size) +
      as.integer(high_price_concentration) +
      as.integer(unusual_department_combination),

    final_score =
      risk_score * 2 +
      as.numeric(scale(total_price)) +
      as.numeric(scale(abs(price_deviation))) +
      as.numeric(scale(abs(time_deviation))) * 0.5
  )

top_150 <- case0_basket %>%
  arrange(desc(final_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

writeLines(as.character(top_150$transaction_id))

readr::write_csv(
  top_150,
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/test cases/top_150"
)
```

```{r}

    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Fast / slow scan thresholds
p5_time  <- quantile(basket_data$avg_time_per_item, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_time <- quantile(basket_data$avg_time_per_item, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Basket size group
basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    fast_flag = avg_time_per_item < p5_time,
    slow_flag = avg_time_per_item > p95_time,

    basket_size_group = case_when(
      total_items <= 10 ~ "small",
      total_items <= 25 ~ "medium",

    )
  )

# 4. Expected time given basket size

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_time_given_size = predict(model_time, newdata = basket_data),

# 6. Department co-occurrence score
dept_data <- long_data_clean %>%

pairs <- dept_data %>%

# 7. Thresholds for risk rules
p5_resid  <- quantile(basket_data$price_residual, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_resid <- quantile(basket_data$price_residual, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p95_conc <- quantile(basket_data$price_concentration, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
p5_co <- quantile(basket_data$co_occurrence_score, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

# 8. Rule-based risk score
basket_risk <- basket_data %>%
```

# ЧИСТЫЙ IF - case 1

```{r}
# ISOLATION FOREST ON basket_data

library(isotree)

# 1. Basket-level features for IF
if_train <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# 2. Matrix for IF
X_train_raw <- if_train %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_train <- scale(X_train_raw)

# 3. Fit IF on supermarket basket data
if_model <- isolation.forest(
  as.matrix(X_train),
  ntrees = 300,
  sample_size = 512,
  ndim = 1,
  nthreads = 1
)

# 4. Get anomaly scores on supermarket
if_train$if_score <- predict(
  if_model,
  as.matrix(X_train),
  type = "score"
)

# 5. Since known fraud rate is about 15%, flag top 15%
if_threshold <- quantile(if_train$if_score, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE)

if_train <- if_train %>%
  mutate(
    if_flag = if_score >= if_threshold
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score))

table(if_train$if_flag)

# Top suspicious supermarket transactions according to IF
top_if_train <- if_train %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

View(top_if_train)

write.csv(
  top_if_train,
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/case1 just IF/top_if_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


top_if_train %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    if_score
  ) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
ggplot(if_train, aes(x = avg_time_per_item, y = total_price, color = if_flag)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#D32F2F")) +
  labs(
    title = "Isolation Forest anomalies on supermarket",
    subtitle = "Top 15% anomaly scores are flagged",
    x = "Average time per item (seconds)",
    y = "Total basket value (€)",
    color = "IF anomaly"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# APPLY IF test case1

```{r}
lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case1.csv", warn = FALSE)

case1_raw <- tibble(
  row_id = 1:length(lines),
  raw_line = lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case1_long <- case1_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case1_basket <- case1_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_time = min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_price / total_time, NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

if_case1 <- case1_basket %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(if_train$sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(if_train$price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_case1_raw <- if_case1 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case1 <- scale(
  X_case1_raw,
  center = attr(X_train, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_train, "scaled:scale")
)

if_case1$if_score <- predict(
  if_model,
  as.matrix(X_case1),
  type = "score"
)

if_case1 <- if_case1 %>%
  mutate(
    if_flag = if_score >= if_threshold
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score))

top_150_if_case1 <- if_case1 %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_if_case1$transaction_id))

readr::write_csv(
  top_150_if_case1,
```

# CASE 2: baseline based on supermarket + IF based on supermarket

```{r}
# ==========================================
# COMBINED MODEL ON SUPERMARKET ONLY
# baseline on basket_data + IF on basket_data
# weights: 0.6 baseline / 0.4 IF
# ==========================================

library(tidyverse)
library(isotree)
library(readr)

# ------------------------------------------
# 1. TRAIN DATA: supermarket
# ------------------------------------------

train_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

train_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(train_lines),
  basket = train_lines
)

train_long <- train_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 2. basket_data
# ------------------------------------------

basket_data <- train_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time = max(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_time = min(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- train_long %>%
  count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    department_diversity_ratio = unique_departments / total_items,
    items_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_items / total_time, NA_real_)
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 3. Models for deviations
# ------------------------------------------

model_time <- lm(avg_time_per_item ~ total_items, data = basket_data)
model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_time_given_size = predict(model_time, newdata = basket_data),
    time_deviation = avg_time_per_item - expected_time_given_size,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items,
    price_residual = residuals(model_price),
    price_concentration = max_price / total_price
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 4. Co-occurrence score
# ------------------------------------------

dept_data <- train_long %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

pairs <- dept_data %>%
  inner_join(dept_data, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  rename(
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

co_occurrence <- pairs %>%
  count(dept_1, dept_2, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(score = n / max(n))

pairs_scored <- pairs %>%
  left_join(co_occurrence, by = c("dept_1", "dept_2"))

co_score <- pairs_scored %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    co_occurrence_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(co_score, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    co_occurrence_score = replace_na(co_occurrence_score, 0)
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 5. Baseline thresholds
# ------------------------------------------

p5_time  <- quantile(basket_data$avg_time_per_item, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_time <- quantile(basket_data$avg_time_per_item, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p5_price  <- quantile(basket_data$total_price, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_price <- quantile(basket_data$total_price, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p5_resid  <- quantile(basket_data$price_residual, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
p95_resid <- quantile(basket_data$price_residual, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

p95_conc <- quantile(basket_data$price_concentration, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
p5_co <- quantile(basket_data$co_occurrence_score, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------
# 6. Baseline score on supermarket
# ------------------------------------------

basket_train <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    fast_scan = avg_time_per_item < p5_time,
    slow_scan = avg_time_per_item > p95_time,
    low_total_price = total_price < p5_price,
    high_total_price = total_price > p95_price,
    unusually_cheap_for_size = price_deviation < p5_resid,
    unusually_expensive_for_size = price_deviation > p95_resid,
    high_price_concentration = price_concentration > p95_conc,
    unusual_department_combination = co_occurrence_score < p5_co,

    risk_score =
      as.integer(fast_scan) +
      as.integer(slow_scan) +
      as.integer(low_total_price) +
      as.integer(high_total_price) +
      as.integer(unusually_cheap_for_size) +
      as.integer(unusually_expensive_for_size) +
      as.integer(high_price_concentration) +
      as.integer(unusual_department_combination),

    final_score =
      risk_score * 2 +
      as.numeric(scale(total_price)) +
      as.numeric(scale(abs(price_deviation))) +
      as.numeric(scale(abs(time_deviation))) * 0.5
  )

# ------------------------------------------
# 7. IF on supermarket
# ------------------------------------------

if_train <- basket_train %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_train_raw <- if_train %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_train <- scale(X_train_raw)

if_model <- isolation.forest(
  as.matrix(X_train),
  ntrees = 300,
  sample_size = 512,
  ndim = 1,
  nthreads = 1
)

if_train$if_score <- predict(
  if_model,
  as.matrix(X_train),
  type = "score"
)

# ------------------------------------------
# 8. Merge baseline + IF on supermarket
# ------------------------------------------

basket_train <- basket_train %>%
  left_join(
    if_train %>% select(transaction_id, if_score),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_score_01 = percent_rank(final_score),
    if_score_01 = percent_rank(if_score),
    combined_score = 0.6 * baseline_score_01 + 0.4 * if_score_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_score))

# ------------------------------------------
# 9. Inspect top 150 on supermarket
# ------------------------------------------

top_150_combined_train <- basket_train %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

write_csv(
  top_150_combined_train,
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/top_150_combined_train.csv"
)

top_150_combined_train %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    price_deviation,
    time_deviation,
    price_concentration,
    co_occurrence_score,
    risk_score,
    final_score,
    if_score,
    combined_score
  ) %>%
  head(20)

```

# ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНО МОЖНО ПОПРОБОВАТЬ ИЗМЕНИТЬ!!!!!!!!!

# 1. ДОБАВИЛИ НОВЫЕ ПЕРЕМЕННЫЕ В ЧИСТЫЙ IF

```{r}
# 1. Basket-level features for IF
if_train <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    items_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    department_diversity_ratio,
    dominant_department_share,
    price_deviation,
    time_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_second = replace_na(items_per_second, median(items_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    department_diversity_ratio = replace_na(department_diversity_ratio, median(department_diversity_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)),
    time_deviation = replace_na(time_deviation, median(time_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# 2. Matrix for IF
X_train_raw <- if_train %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_train <- scale(X_train_raw)

# 3. Fit IF on supermarket basket data
if_model <- isolation.forest(
  as.matrix(X_train),
  ntrees = 300,
  sample_size = 512,
  ndim = 1,
  nthreads = 1
)

# 4. Get anomaly scores on supermarket
if_train$if_score <- predict(
  if_model,
  as.matrix(X_train),
  type = "score"
)

# 5. Since known fraud rate is about 15%, flag top 15%
if_threshold <- quantile(if_train$if_score, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE)

if_train <- if_train %>%
  mutate(
    if_flag = if_score >= if_threshold
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score))

table(if_train$if_flag)

# Top suspicious supermarket transactions according to IF
top_if_train <- if_train %>%
  arrange(desc(if_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

View(top_if_train)

write.csv(
  top_if_train,
  "~/Desktop/supermarket case/case2 just IF/top_if_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

top_if_train %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    items_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    department_diversity_ratio,
    dominant_department_share,
    price_deviation,
    time_deviation,
    if_score
  ) %>%
  head(20)
```
